paragraphs: (Gedaliah son of Achikam; Jeremiah 40:8.) R' Shmuel son of Gedaliah, alternatively bar Guria; Tanchuma, Behar 2.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Masorah Jeremiah 40:8 verse names Gedaliah without his father; the adjacent whole 40:7 verse explicitly names Gedaliahu son of Achikam. This is a positive comparison, not a repair of Hyman’s 40:8 locator. The whole Buber 1885 Tanchuma Behar 2 paragraph reads abbreviated R' Shmuel ben Gedaliah. The whole Torat Emet Behar 2 paragraph does not name him, a bounded nonmatch only. Bar Guria remains Hyman’s uncollated variant, without merging the biblical Gedaliah and the separate patronymic.
